faq.q: How much does it cost to build a SaaS MVP?
faq.a: It depends on the number of user roles, core workflows and integrations. After a discovery call we send a written scope with a fixed price, and we help you cut anything that isn't needed for your first customers.

faq.q: How long does an MVP take?
faq.a: It depends on scope. We plan the build in phases so you have a working product to show users early, then add features based on their feedback.
Yes. We design multi-tenant architecture from the start: organisations or workspaces with isolated data, roles, per-tenant settings and billing.

faq.q: Can you take over an MVP another team built?
faq.a: Yes. We audit the code, fix what blocks growth and continue development, or recommend a rebuild only where it's genuinely cheaper. See our legacy modernization service.

faq.q: Who owns the code and IP?
faq.a: You do. Everything lives in your repositories and cloud accounts, and on final payment all code and IP is yours.

faq.q: Do you work with non-technical founders?
faq.a: Yes. We explain technical decisions in plain language, write the product spec with you and act as your technical team until you hire your own.

cta.label: Start Your Product
cta.p: Share the idea and who it's for. We'll reply within 24 hours with how we'd scope the first version.
